title: Eye _lastFailedSwapStamp 10-min auto-expiry
desc: _lastFailedSwapStamp permanently blocked future hot-swaps after a single transient failure. _lastFailedSwapStampUtc tracks recording time; 10-min expiry path clears the guard and retries swap automatically.
steps: On stamp match check (UtcNow - stamp) >= 10min and clear if expired
Reset both fields together on swap success or NoNewExe path
Verify with: wkappbot eye hotswap status (after fix; stamp expired after 10 min idle)

requirements.expect: Failed-stamp expired log on stale stamp >=10min
